notes: Partition verified: 16 source and 20 target IDs each covered once across 14 units.
לְמַעְלָה fuses preposition, noun and directive *he* into *upward* under rules 30 and 32 — three contiguous morphemes, one English word, headed on the lexeme-bearer.
*there shall be* joins the numeral predicate under rule 20's presentative clause, and the article on הַקְּרָנוֹת is `unrepresented` since the ASV writes *four horns* with no *the*.

הַרְאֵל → *upper altar* and אֲרִיאֵל → *altar hearth* are genuine rule 31 ties (neither English word alone loses the lexeme), broken on the English head noun under rule 24's tie-breaker; the notes say so.
